weight_scope: active-classes-only; dataset.cfg.class_weights is transformed internally by DataProcessing.get_class_weights before CrossEntropyLoss is constructed
weight_list_length: num_classes=3 for this project; ignored label 0 is omitted after filter_valid_label reduces labels
class_order: [road, lane, other] after ignored label 0 is filtered out and labels are reduced to contiguous active-class indices
short_note: SemSegLoss reads dataset.cfg.class_weights, converts that list with DataProcessing.get_class_weights, and then builds a float32 torch CrossEntropyLoss weight tensor for the active classes only.
